rationale: No approved product-level RF or detector requirements exist. These conservative numeric gates characterize the Phase 2 CPU candidates and are not external conformance limits.

sampled_band_model.representability_statement: The 500 Msps complex input represents only explicitly configured distinct IQ offsets inside guarded Nyquist. RF table values are semantic metadata and are never interpreted as simultaneous sampled RF carriers.

channelizer.algorithm: per-channel complex mix, normalized odd-length Hamming-window FIR, then decimate
channelizer.alias_measurement: Measure positive and negative isolated tones in every D=10 folding region from the declared 12 MHz stopband edge through 250 MHz input Nyquist, plus simultaneous folding-band multitone and dense stopband vectors. Record input and post-filter/decimated power and compare every candidate sample with an independent FIR/decimation oracle.
channelizer.transition_width_definition: Frequency from the 2.5 MHz passband edge to the first measured candidate-response point at or below the 50 dB stopband requirement.
channelizer.equivalent_noise_bandwidth_definition: 500 MHz times actual candidate impulse-response energy divided by squared actual DC gain.
channelizer.allocation_high_water_definition: Observed deterministic runtime allocation counter for the selected input copy, all 64 FIR histories, and all 64 candidate output vectors; not a configured bound or process RSS estimate.
channelizer.packet_contract: globally contiguous tokens; FIR state retained; causal tail is not zero-padded; EOS propagates after final available filtered sample

detector.search_model: arbitrary capture epoch with bounded buffering, at least 50 percent background samples, and EOS finalization
detector.noise_estimator: with the declared at-least-50-percent-background capture contract, the whole-capture 20th power percentile is conservatively mapped to the noise-only 40th percentile and divided by -ln(0.6)
detector.threshold_definition: 8-channel-sample moving-average power compared with max(absolute floor, estimated noise power * 8), with 0.5 release hysteresis and window-delay start refinement
detector.integration_operating_point: unit-amplitude independent clean capture; validates acquisition, frequency identity, timing propagation, EOS, and downstream graph completion but does not qualify payload-word accuracy after causal channel filtering
detector.false_alarm_definition: accepted detections not overlapping a truth pulse divided by searched channel samples; per-second value multiplies by channel sample rate
detector.state_and_eos: the reusable detector candidate accepts at most 4194304 channel samples; the checked full-graph integration topology deliberately overrides this to 419431 channel samples; detections are emitted on terminal control and state resets after terminal, rejection, failure, cancellation, or reconfiguration
detector.configured_vs_estimated: No configured noise-floor value is accepted or exposed as a measurement. noise_floor_db and snr_db in output metadata are calculated from IQ evidence.
detector.allocation_high_water_definition: Observed deterministic runtime allocation counter for capture state, kernel power/sorted/smoothed/range work vectors, and emitted pulse metadata/evidence vectors; not a configured bound or process RSS estimate.

statistics.flaky_gate_policy: gate aggregate held-out confidence bounds; never fail only because a single randomized trial crosses a threshold
statistics.failure_artifacts: minimized vector plus profile hash, seed, scenario parameters, and SHA-256

threshold_freeze.workflow: Select provisional thresholds only with architecture constraints, analytical design bounds, and development_seeds; serialize and hash the threshold set; then run evaluation_seeds without modifying thresholds. Any threshold change creates a new hash and invalidates prior evaluation evidence.

channelizer_filter_shape.origin: architecture occupied bandwidth plus guarded decimated Nyquist
channelizer_filter_shape.rationale: 241-tap Hamming FIR provides a reproducible CPU baseline with explicit group delay
channelizer_filter_shape.evidence_partition: analytical design bounds and development vectors only

channelizer_selectivity_and_alias.rationale: 50 dB is below the measured development response while leaving margin for implementation error

channelizer_near_far.rationale: wanted output must remain at least 20 dB above measured adjacent leakage
channelizer_near_far.evidence_partition: development near/far sweep; frozen before evaluation

detector_thresholds.rationale: 8x noise, 0.5 release, and 0.75 coherence reject recorded development CW/chirp/impulse/wrong-rate cases while retaining the declared 10 dB point
detector_thresholds.evidence_partition: development seeds 1101-1104; held-out evaluation seeds prohibited

detector_performance.rationale: 95 percent detection, 1e-6 false detections per searched sample, and 160-input-sample p95 timing are engineering gates rather than product requirements

unsupported: captures with less than 50 percent background samples for robust noise estimation
overlapping same-channel bursts that cannot be separated by energy
payload-word accuracy through the causal Phase 2 channel filter; decoder matched-filter/equalization qualification is deferred
hardware, OTA, regulatory, interoperability, or product qualification
